column7:
Reasons for final saving
have not been intimated
(July 2025).

Reduction in provision
of ₹20.00 lakh was the
net effect of increase of
₹120.00 lakh and
decrease by re-
appropriation of
₹140.00 lakh. Increase
was attributed to need
of additional amount in
maintenance and repair.
Decrease was attributed
to anticipated saving.
Final saving of ₹206.82
lakh is understated by
₹42.48 lakh due to
clearance of OB
suspense related to
previous years. Reasons
for actual final saving
of ₹249.30 lakh have
notbeenintimated(July
2025).
